paper-a.statement: Seasonal naive is a supported default baseline for weekly demand series.
paper-a.quote: We therefore recommend seasonal naive as the default baseline for weekly demand.

rejected_claim.statement: Seasonal naive improves every weekly demand forecast by at least 25 percent.
rejected_claim.quote: Seasonal naive improves every weekly demand forecast by at least 25 percent.

paper-b.statement: Excluding series shorter than 52 weeks is unnecessary and discards usable data.
paper-b.quote: Excluding short series therefore discards usable data and biases results toward mature products.

paper-c.note: Uses the words baseline and exclusion in a clinical trial; unrelated.
